method: targeted Kyrgyz-English semantic review against printed page and adjacent context; inventory-142 manuscript alignment remains provisional
checked_by: Codex with parallel agent proposals reviewed by root

lexical_refs.заар: https://el-sozduk.kg/%D0%B7%D0%B0%D0%B0%D1%80/ — fierceness, wrath, severity in epic use
lexical_refs.бейпай: https://el-sozduk.kg/%D0%B1%D0%B5%D0%B9%D0%BF%D0%B0%D0%B9/ — suffering or turmoil; бейпайга сал- inflicts suffering
lexical_refs.касам: https://el-sozduk.kg/%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BC/ — oath; line 29 may instead reflect казам (fate/death), unresolved

uncertainty: Rows 7–31 contain first-person Sarybay speech but no extracted opening quotation mark. Page 982 ends in third-person narration; page 983 row 54 begins another explicit quote. Do not infer exact quotation boundary from this text alone.
Rows 10, 23, 27 and 29 have unclear or possibly corrupt wording. Proposed English preserves defensible gist and requires printed-page/lexical review before adoption.
The form жолундуу in row 23 was not confirmed in the consulted dictionary; the English is context-led.
Row 29's касам literally means oath, while epic kazam/ажал idiom might be intended; check scan before changing source text.
Row 45 has opaque жагданып жибек бөлүнбөй; proposed English is deliberately literal and requires specialist review against the printed scan.
Row 48's аркардын жибек белиндей metaphor is kept close to the Kyrgyz; exact physical referent of silk-like waist is uncertain.
Row 67's collocation укурук калбай, жан калбай is kept literal; scope of the lasso/pole image is uncertain.
Row 80 is the first line of a sentence continuing onto page 984; калмышында means in the end, but the sentence referent requires that continuation.

corrections.en: He had kept the tumult raging.
corrections.reason: Чууга сал- is to throw into uproar; continues page 982 battle narration.

corrections.en: Strength spent, exhausted,
corrections.reason: Чама is strength or capacity here, not a person's name; ал кетип means strength departed.

corrections.en: Blood flowed from our bodies,
corrections.reason: Денебизден is first-person plural, from our bodies.

corrections.en: For saliva sweeter than sugar,
corrections.reason: Together with next line, the speaker longs for even one swallow.

corrections.en: We longed for a single swallow.
corrections.reason: Бир жутууга зар болду expresses desperate longing for one swallow; pronoun follows our bodies in row 3.

corrections.en: Bravo, Kuyaly!
corrections.reason: Баракелде is praise or admiration, not a blessing noun.

corrections.old: What can I say without Bali,
corrections.en: How could I fail to say, 'Well done'?
corrections.reason: Бали is an exclamation of praise, not the place name.

corrections.old: Your courage is strong, your urine is strong,
corrections.en: Your valor is mighty, your wrath fierce;
corrections.reason: Заар has figurative epic sense fierceness or wrath, not urine in this context.

corrections.en: I set Sarybay straight.
corrections.reason: Conservative first-person rendering of Сарыбайды кылдым түз without deciding the uncertain speaker change.

corrections.en: My poor head was sorely tried,
corrections.reason: Башка is dative 'to the head,' not adjective 'other'; башына күч келүү expresses affliction.

corrections.en: The final ordeal came upon me.
corrections.reason: Акыр-такыр signals the utter/endmost stage; иш is trouble in this lament.

corrections.en: I was Sarybay the khan,
corrections.reason: Кан here is the title khan, not blood; first-person speech.

corrections.en: From time immemorial,
corrections.reason: Ар качандан бир качан is a temporal epic formula; smooth without adding an event.

corrections.en: At every turn,
corrections.reason: Ар дайымдан бир дайым reiterates habitual recurrence.

corrections.en: Fighting had been my custom.
corrections.reason: Кагыш кылган адатым names the habit as combat, with no 'bad' modifier.

corrections.en: Countless armies
corrections.reason: Кол means an army or troop in epic battle context, not anatomical hands.

corrections.en: I fought and crushed,
corrections.reason: Кагыш кылып is to fight; clause continues into next line.

corrections.en: And cast them all into misery.
corrections.reason: Бейпайга салдым баарысын means caused all to suffer, not free acquisition.

corrections.en: I used to fell the middling ones;
corrections.reason: Чамалууну is the moderately capable person, object of чалчу элек (habitual 'used to strike/fell'), not a name.

corrections.old: If you want to fight the stump
corrections.en: When a fierce fighting foe came,
corrections.reason: Чабышкан дүмөк жоо is a fighting, tumultuous enemy; conditional келсе, not a wish.

corrections.old: He didn't put it on his back,
corrections.en: I used to lay him flat on his back.
corrections.reason: Чалкасынан салчу элек is affirmative habitual in the speaker's first-person account.

corrections.old: He did not destroy the road,
corrections.en: I used to destroy even the formidable ones,
corrections.reason: Жойчу элек is affirmative habitual; жолундууну denotes a type of adversary here, not 'the road'; exact lexical sense uncertain.

corrections.en: And those who crept close,
corrections.reason: Жойлоп is a manner of coming close, not a name.

corrections.en: I used to gouge out their glaring eyes.
corrections.reason: Көзүн ойчу элек is affirmative habitual 'used to gouge out the eye'; кашайткан qualifies the eyes.

corrections.en: When they came swaggering,
corrections.reason: Кулжуңдаша кеткенде indicates taunting or cocky behavior, not departure by 'you'.

corrections.en: I left them at their wits' end,
corrections.reason: Айласын кетирип is to deprive of recourse; күн may add a 'daylight' nuance not captured here.

corrections.old: He put it on his back.
corrections.en: And laid them flat on their backs.
corrections.reason: Чалкасынан салчу элек repeats speaker's habitual victory, as at row 22.

corrections.en: Yet my appointed end had not come.
corrections.reason: Context contrasts past victories with surviving to face Kuyaly; касам is lexically 'oath' and may be a source variant or typo, so this is provisional.

corrections.old: The discharge is severe, the urine is strong,
corrections.en: Swift to flee, fierce in wrath,
corrections.reason: Качышы is fleeing, заары wrath/fierceness; not medical discharge and urine.

corrections.old: I've never seen you like that.
corrections.en: My dear, I had never seen your like.
corrections.reason: Сендей көрбөдүм means never saw one like you; кайраным is an address.

corrections.old: I heard from the reporter yesterday.
corrections.en: Yesterday I heard word from a messenger,
corrections.reason: Кабарчы is messenger or news bearer in the epic setting; keep sentence flowing into next line.

corrections.en: My tiny life trembled,
corrections.reason: Чымын жаным is figurative 'my frail life'; чыркырап is shrill quivering or crying.

corrections.en: The bones of my thighs shuddered,
corrections.reason: Дал сан сөөгүм is thigh bone; быркырап expresses rattling/shuddering, not necessarily a literal fracture.

corrections.en: My ribs throbbed,
corrections.reason: Боконо сөөгүм names ribs specifically; болкулдап conveys throbbing or jolting.

corrections.en: My insides heaved without cease,
corrections.reason: Ичим солкулдап evokes internal trembling; болбой intensifies the distress.

corrections.en: The news spread among the people:
corrections.reason: Калкка кабар билинген says the news became known to the people; next line gives its content.

corrections.en: 'A fearsome fiend has come,' they said.
corrections.reason: Кара тажаал is a terrible fiend, not boredom; келди деп reports what was said.

corrections.en: Poor champion Sarybay,
corrections.reason: Кайран is an epithet of pity; балбан is champion or wrestler; continuation in row 41 completes sentence.

corrections.en: He despaired of his precious life.
corrections.reason: кайран жан refers to dear life, түңүлгөн to losing hope; not another disappointment.

corrections.en: The wretched man writhed in anguish,
corrections.reason: бейтаалай is hapless person and чымырканган describes straining or writhing, not an insect.

corrections.en: Time after time,
corrections.reason: ар качандан бир качан is temporal formula; smooth syntax with next line.

corrections.en: He had suffered in this way.
corrections.reason: жапаа салып has suffering or affliction, omitted by draft.

corrections.en: The silk settled close without parting,
corrections.reason: Retains жибек бөлүнбөй and attempts жагданып; opaque phrase, flagged uncertain.

corrections.old: You did bad things and quarreled.
corrections.en: You did wrong by stirring up strife,
corrections.reason: чыр салып is to cause strife; direct second-person rebuke.

corrections.old: You don't look like a shepherd.
corrections.en: You show no sign of sparing a life.
corrections.reason: жан койчу means let a life be, not a livestock shepherd; түрүң көрүнбөй concerns appearance of mercy.

corrections.en: Like the silken waist of an argali,
corrections.reason: аркар is wild mountain sheep, not a proper name; keeps metaphor close.

corrections.en: When I look at your fierce bearing,
corrections.reason: айбат is imposing or fearsome bearing.

corrections.old: Like a cold breeze from the pass.
corrections.en: It is like the cold wind of a mountain pass.
corrections.reason: Retains simile while connecting to previous line's bearing.

corrections.en: With a low, swelling hum,
corrections.reason: күү-күү is onomatopoeic sound and күүлөнүп describes building force here.

corrections.en: Muttering deep in his throat,
corrections.reason: күңгүрөнүп depicts low rumbling speech, not necessarily grumpiness.

corrections.en: Sarybay thundered:
corrections.reason: күркүрөдү is rumbling or thundering; prior lines describe his voice.

corrections.en: "Since I became Sarybay,
corrections.reason: болгону begins temporal sequence with конгону in next line.

corrections.old: When Sarybai got on the horse,
corrections.en: Since I mounted a horse as Sarybay,
corrections.reason: First-person speech continues; атка конгону means mounted a horse or set out as a rider.

corrections.en: Since I came of age and became a warrior,
corrections.reason: эрешен тартып эр болуп is coming to maturity and becoming a man/hero.

corrections.en: A match for the sons of warriors,
corrections.reason: эр уулуна means a brave man's son, not his son.

corrections.en: Since I put on a golden crown,
corrections.reason: Participates in temporal sequence leading to rule.

corrections.old: I rode on a golden throne,
corrections.en: Since I ascended a golden throne,
corrections.reason: такка мингеним is enthronement, not literal riding.

corrections.old: The people rule, the people wait,
corrections.en: I ruled the people and cared for the land,
corrections.reason: First-person subject continues; калк башкарып, журт күтүп means governing people and maintaining realm.

corrections.old: I used to be a sarybai.
corrections.en: I have lived as Sarybay.
corrections.reason: Sarybay is speaker's name, not common noun.

corrections.old: There is blood in the court,
corrections.en: I held court and became a khan,
corrections.reason: кан is khan in ордо тутуп, кан болуп, not blood.

corrections.en: A chief seated in authority,
corrections.reason: бий means ruler or judge, not dance; орунтуктуу denotes established position.

corrections.old: Gather the people and hold the people,
corrections.en: I gathered the people and held the realm,
corrections.reason: First-person narrative; калк and журт distinguish people and polity.

corrections.en: Riding the clouds and scattering ice,
corrections.reason: Participial boasts belong to Sarybay's past, not separate weather clauses.

corrections.en: In those days when I roared,
corrections.reason: күжүлдөгөн кезекте recalls roaring past vigor.

corrections.old: No loop left, no soul left,
corrections.en: Leaving neither a horse-catching pole nor a living soul,
corrections.reason: укурук is a horse-catching pole with a noose; keeps hyperbole literal and flagged uncertain.

corrections.en: I scattered their very core,
corrections.reason: уютку is core or starter; быт кылып means breaking apart and scattering, not sweetening.

corrections.old: There are no animals left untouched by me.
corrections.en: No herd escaped my raids,
corrections.reason: мал is livestock and тийбеген in boastful raid context means untouched or unraided.

corrections.en: My Zulpukor sword and my steel spear,
corrections.reason: Зулпукор names a legendary sharp sword, paired here with steel spear; not an oppressor.

corrections.en: When I brandished them,
corrections.reason: күүлөп with weapons means swinging or flourishing, not singing.

corrections.en: All the vast heavens
corrections.reason: асман-көк is expansive sky/heavens, not an incomplete nominal phrase.

corrections.en: I held in my power in those days,
corrections.reason: Completes previous all-heavens object without adding an unsupported “seemed”.

corrections.en: I sliced and ate the choicest horse haunch,
corrections.reason: жая is prized horse rump/haunch cut, not an unspecified object.

corrections.old: I was wondering where the naked man is.
corrections.en: And asked, 'Where is the death-bringer?'
corrections.reason: жалаңкыч denotes reaper or terrifying foe, not a naked man.

corrections.en: I sliced and ate horse-rib fat,
corrections.reason: казы is prized horse rib or belly fat, not goose (каз).

corrections.old: I was wondering where Balaket is.
corrections.en: And asked, 'Where is calamity?'
corrections.reason: балакет means misfortune/calamity, not proper name; parallel to death-bringer boast.

corrections.en: Oh, wretched Kuyaly,
corrections.reason: оңбогон is reproach or curse, not compassionate poor.

corrections.en: I have suffered greatly because of you.
corrections.reason: сенден көп күйдүм is speaker's distress caused by Kuyaly, not comparison of burns.

corrections.en: In the end, to this warrior,
corrections.reason: эр is man/warrior; калмышында means in the end according to Yudakhin; fragment continues on page 984.
